notes: This is the 23 August 2026 statement snapshot, not live positions or prices. Rows whose expiry has passed remain because the statement lists them; no settlement, assignment, or closeout is inferred.
Current option quotes, quote dates, signed quantities, marks, and explicit Covered/Blocked remarks were read from the new statement. Missing current-price dates remain null.

Gross strike amounts illustrate full exercise-price cash exchanged for all listed short puts or calls of the indicated group; they are not loss, current margin, or remaining real-world obligations. Calls represent proceeds against delivery, not a cash payment requirement. Expiry-reached rows are separated because their subsequent settlement status is unknown.

FUBO1 is explicitly present in this statement. Its displayed 8-share deliverable is distinct from its 100 strike/premium multiplier. Official OCC memo 58712 verifies 8 FUBO shares plus USD 4.40 fixed cash per contract.
ASM2 is an ASML mini equity option with a ten-share contract; the numeral in its symbol is not evidence of a corporate-action adjustment. 2FE is Ferrari; APQ is SAP on Euronext Amsterdam.
Exact exchange rates use printed pp57-58. Source row FX quotes are rounded and were not substituted for the exact rates.
Absence of Covered or Blocked remarks does not prove an uncovered position. No underlying spot price, realized option profit, or available collateral is inferred.
